lines.say: Gravity bends light. The Sun bends the light that passes close to it.
lines.en: Gravity bends light. The Sun bends the light that passes close to it.
lines.ja: 重力は光を曲げます。太陽は、そのすぐそばを通る光を曲げます。

lines.say: Far beyond the planets, this bent light comes together, as in a lens.
lines.en: Far beyond the planets, this bent light comes together, as in a lens.
lines.ja: 惑星たちよりずっと遠くで、曲がった光は、レンズのように一つに集まります。

lines.say: Some scientists propose to put a telescope there, and take pictures of planets of other stars.
lines.en: Some scientists propose to put a telescope there, and take pictures of planets of other stars.
lines.ja: そこに望遠鏡を置いて、ほかの恒星の惑星を写すことを提案している研究者たちがいます。

lines.say: This is called imaging with the solar gravitational lens.
lines.en: This is called imaging with the solar gravitational lens.
lines.ja: これを、太陽重力レンズによる撮像と呼びます。

lines.say: A twenty twenty-six paper asks: in a simple model of this imaging, what limits the detail of the picture?
lines.en: A 2026 paper asks: in a simple model of this imaging, what limits the detail of the picture?
lines.ja: 2026 年のある論文は問いました。この撮像の簡単なモデルで、写真の細かさを限るものは何か。

lines.say: The paper does not say whether or when a mission could take such a picture.
lines.en: The paper does not say whether or when a mission could take such a picture.
lines.ja: 論文は、任務がそうした写真を撮れるかどうかや、その時期については、何も述べていません。

lines.say: In the paper's baseline, the target has an Earth-like surface, and is thirty parsecs away.
lines.en: In the paper's baseline, the target has an Earth-like surface, and is 30 parsecs away.
lines.ja: 論文の基本の設定では、狙う惑星は地球のような表面を持ち、30 パーセク離れています。

lines.say: The telescope is six hundred and fifty times as far from the Sun as the Earth is. Its opening is one metre wide.
lines.en: The telescope is 650 times as far from the Sun as the Earth is. Its opening is 1 metre wide.
lines.ja: 望遠鏡は、太陽から地球までの距離の 650 倍の所にあります。口径は 1 m です。

lines.say: The telescope moves across the image of the planet, one step for each pixel of the picture.
lines.en: The telescope moves across the image of the planet, one step for each pixel of the picture.
lines.ja: 望遠鏡は、惑星の像の上を、写真の 1 画素ごとに 1 歩ずつ動きます。

lines.say: The picture has one hundred and twenty-eight by one hundred and twenty-eight pixels. One pixel covers ninety-nine point five kilometres of the planet.
lines.en: The picture has 128 by 128 pixels. One pixel covers 99.5 kilometres of the planet.
lines.ja: 写真は 128 × 128 画素です。1 画素は、惑星の上の 99.5 km に当たります。

lines.say: At each step, the telescope gets the light of its own pixel. It also gets a faint blur of light from all the other pixels.
lines.en: At each step, the telescope gets the light of its own pixel. It also gets a faint blur of light from all the other pixels.
lines.ja: 1 歩ごとに、望遠鏡は自分の画素の光を受けます。ほかの全ての画素からも、淡くぼやけた光を受けます。

lines.say: So the data are a mix. A computation must take the mix apart to recover the picture.
lines.en: So the data are a mix. A computation must take the mix apart to recover the picture.
lines.ja: そのため、データは混ざっています。写真を取り戻すには、計算で混ざりを解かなければなりません。

scenes.title: Three barriers and one bound
scenes.title_ja: 三つの壁と一つの下限

lines.say: The paper looks at three things that limit the picture.
lines.en: The paper looks at three things that limit the picture.
lines.ja: 論文は、写真を限る三つのものを調べます。

lines.say: The first is the corona, the faint glow around the Sun. Its light adds random noise.
lines.en: The first is the corona, the faint glow around the Sun. Its light adds random noise.
lines.ja: 一つ目はコロナ、太陽を囲む淡い光です。その光が、でたらめな雑音を加えます。

lines.say: The second is clouds. They hide parts of the surface, and they change from one visit to the next.
lines.en: The second is clouds. They hide parts of the surface, and they change from one visit to the next.
lines.ja: 二つ目は雲です。雲は表面の一部を隠し、訪れるたびに形を変えます。

lines.say: The third is the shape of the Sun's gravity. It is not perfectly round. So the lens spreads each point into a small pattern, called a caustic.
lines.en: The third is the shape of the Sun's gravity. It is not perfectly round. So the lens spreads each point into a small pattern, called a caustic.
lines.ja: 三つ目は、太陽の重力の形です。完全には丸くありません。そのためレンズは、一つの点を、コースティクスと呼ぶ小さな模様に広げます。

lines.say: The paper puts all three into one simple model. In this model, the parts add up, and the random parts follow the bell curve.
lines.en: The paper puts all three into one simple model. In this model, the parts add up, and the random parts follow the bell curve.
lines.ja: 論文は、三つを一つの簡単なモデルに入れます。このモデルでは、各部分は足し合わされ、でたらめな部分は釣り鐘の形の分布に従います。

lines.say: For this model, the paper computes a bound: the smallest error that an unbiased method can have.
lines.en: For this model, the paper computes a bound: the smallest error that an unbiased method can have.
lines.ja: このモデルについて、論文は下限を計算します。偏りの無い方法が持ちうる、いちばん小さい誤差です。

lines.say: This bound belongs to the model. It is not a limit for every method.
lines.en: This bound belongs to the model. It is not a limit for every method.
lines.ja: この下限はモデルのものです。あらゆる方法の限界ではありません。

lines.say: A picture can be split into patterns of different sizes, from wide patterns to fine ones.
lines.en: A picture can be split into patterns of different sizes, from wide patterns to fine ones.
lines.ja: 写真は、広い模様から細かい模様まで、いろいろな大きさの模様に分けられます。

lines.say: The paper finds the bound for each size of pattern on its own.
lines.en: The paper finds the bound for each size of pattern on its own.
lines.ja: 論文は、模様の大きさごとに、別々に下限を求めます。

lines.say: Then it removes one barrier at a time, and sees how much the bound goes down.
lines.en: Then it removes one barrier at a time, and sees how much the bound goes down.
lines.ja: 次に、壁を一つずつ取り除き、下限がどれだけ下がるかを見ます。

lines.say: For the widest patterns, about sixteen hundred kilometres and larger, clouds cause the largest loss of information.
lines.en: For the widest patterns, about 1,600 kilometres and larger, clouds cause the largest loss of information.
lines.ja: いちばん広い模様、約 1600 km 以上では、情報を最も多く失わせるのは雲です。

lines.say: For the finest patterns, two hundred kilometres and smaller, the noise from the corona causes the largest loss.
lines.en: For the finest patterns, 200 kilometres and smaller, the noise from the corona causes the largest loss.
lines.ja: いちばん細かい模様、200 km 以下では、最も多く失わせるのはコロナの雑音です。

lines.say: In between, the order changes with the settings. The paper calls it undetermined.
lines.en: In between, the order changes with the settings. The paper calls it undetermined.
lines.ja: その間では、順番が設定によって入れ替わります。論文はこれを未定と呼びます。

lines.say: The shape of the Sun's gravity matters too. In one setting, the information at one size of pattern vanishes.
lines.en: The shape of the Sun's gravity matters too. In one setting, the information at one size of pattern vanishes.
lines.ja: 太陽の重力の形も効きます。ある設定では、ある一つの大きさの模様で、情報が消えてしまいます。

scenes.title: What “finest detail” means
scenes.title_ja: 「いちばん細かい所」の決め方

lines.say: Which barrier sets the finest detail? That depends on how we define the finest detail.
lines.en: Which barrier sets the finest detail? That depends on how we define the finest detail.
lines.ja: では、いちばん細かい所を決めるのはどの壁か。それは、いちばん細かい所をどう定めるかによります。

lines.say: For each size, compare the signal with the error. Call the size seen, if the signal is at least as large as the error.
lines.en: For each size, compare the signal with the error. Call the size seen if the signal is at least as large as the error.
lines.ja: 大きさごとに、信号と誤差を比べます。信号が誤差と同じかそれより大きければ、その大きさは見えた、とします。

lines.say: With one kind of model cloud, the signal falls below the error only in a band of middle sizes, from nine hundred and ten to five hundred and thirty-one kilometres.
lines.en: With one kind of model cloud, the signal falls below the error only in a band of middle sizes, from 910 to 531 kilometres.
lines.ja: ある種類のモデルの雲では、信号が誤差を下回るのは、中くらいの大きさの帯、910〜531 km だけです。

lines.say: Rule one goes from wide to fine, and stops at the first size that is not seen. It stops before the band.
lines.en: Rule one goes from wide to fine, and stops at the first size that is not seen. It stops before the band.
lines.ja: 決め方その一は、広い方から細かい方へ進み、見えない大きさに来たら止まります。帯の手前で止まります。

lines.say: Rule two takes the finest size that is seen, even after a gap. It jumps over the band.
lines.en: Rule two takes the finest size that is seen, even after a gap. It jumps over the band.
lines.ja: 決め方その二は、途中に抜けがあっても、見えたいちばん細かい大きさを取ります。帯を飛び越えます。

lines.say: So, over one hundred and twenty settings, rule one makes clouds the limit in ninety-three, and rule two makes the corona the limit in eighty. The rest are undetermined.
lines.en: So, over 120 settings, rule one makes clouds the limit in 93, and rule two makes the corona the limit in 80. The rest are undetermined.
lines.ja: そのため、120 の設定のうち、決め方その一では 93 で雲が限りとなり、その二では 80 でコロナが限りとなります。残りは未定です。

lines.say: The answer also changes with the other rules, the threshold, and the kind of model cloud.
lines.en: The answer also changes with the other rules, the threshold, and the kind of model cloud.
lines.ja: 答えは、ほかの決め方や、しきい値、モデルの雲の種類によっても変わります。

lines.say: Now take away the clouds, and the shape of the Sun's gravity. Then the finest size seen is six hundred and thirty-seven kilometres after one year of observing, three hundred and fifty-four after ten years, and one hundred and ninety-nine after one hundred years.
lines.en: Now take away the clouds and the shape of the Sun's gravity. Then the finest size seen is 637 kilometres after 1 year of observing, 354 after 10 years, and 199 after 100 years.
lines.ja: 次に、雲と太陽の重力の形を取り除きます。すると、見えるいちばん細かい大きさは、観測 1 年で 637 km、10 年で 354 km、100 年で 199 km です。

lines.say: The model's clouds are simple. Real clouds may differ. So the paper measures real clouds.
lines.en: The model's clouds are simple. Real clouds may differ. So the paper measures real clouds.
lines.ja: モデルの雲は単純です。本物の雲は違うかもしれません。そこで論文は、本物の雲を測ります。

lines.say: It uses pictures of the Earth from Epic, a camera on the Discover spacecraft that sees the whole day side of the Earth.
lines.en: It uses pictures of the Earth from EPIC, a camera on the DSCOVR spacecraft that sees the whole day side of the Earth.
lines.ja: 使うのは、探査機 DSCOVR のカメラ EPIC が撮った地球の写真です。EPIC は、地球の昼の側の全体を写します。

lines.say: The paper uses four months of twenty twenty-four: January, April, July and October. Each day gives two pictures, near midnight and near noon, in universal time.
lines.en: The paper uses four months of 2024: January, April, July and October. Each day gives two pictures, near midnight and near noon, in universal time.
lines.ja: 論文は 2024 年の 4 か月、1 月・4 月・7 月・10 月を使います。1 日に 2 枚、世界時の 0 時ごろと 12 時ごろの写真です。

lines.say: For each spot on the Earth, it takes a low value from the month's pictures. This is the surface. The rest of each picture is the cloud part.
lines.en: For each spot on the Earth, it takes a low value from the month's pictures. This is the surface. The rest of each picture is the cloud part.
lines.ja: 地球の各地点について、その月の写真から低い方の値を取ります。これを表面とします。それぞれの写真の残りが、雲の部分です。

lines.say: How fast the measured clouds change from day to day fits the class of the model.
lines.en: How fast the measured clouds change from day to day fits the class of the model.
lines.ja: 測った雲が日ごとに変わる速さは、モデルの部類に収まりました。

lines.say: With these clouds in the model, the barrier that sets the finest detail is again clouds, the corona, or undetermined, depending on the choices.
lines.en: With these clouds in the model, the barrier that sets the finest detail is again clouds, the corona, or undetermined, depending on the choices.
lines.ja: この雲をモデルに入れても、いちばん細かい所を決める壁は、選び方によって、雲か、コロナか、未定になります。

lines.say: But the real clouds do things that the model does not have. Their values are lopsided and have heavy tails, unlike the bell curve. And they stay alike after two and three days more than the model says.
lines.en: But the real clouds do things that the model does not have. Their values are lopsided and have heavy tails, unlike the bell curve. And they stay alike after two and three days more than the model says.
lines.ja: しかし本物の雲は、モデルに無いふるまいをします。値の分布は片寄っていて裾が重く、釣り鐘の形とは違います。また、2 日後や 3 日後にも、モデルが言うより似たままです。

lines.say: So the paper treats the bound as a property of the model only.
lines.en: So the paper treats the bound as a property of the model only.
lines.ja: そのため論文は、下限をモデルだけの性質として扱います。

lines.say: Next, the paper sends real pictures through the imaging model.
lines.en: Next, the paper sends real pictures through the imaging model.
lines.ja: 次に論文は、本物の写真を、撮像のモデルに通します。

lines.say: The surface from the first half of each month is the truth. The pictures from the second half go through the model, and four methods try to recover the surface.
lines.en: The surface from the first half of each month is the truth. The pictures from the second half go through the model, and four methods try to recover the surface.
lines.ja: 各月の前半から作った表面を、正解とします。後半の写真をモデルに通し、四つの方法で表面を取り戻してみます。

lines.say: For each result, the paper divides the error by the bound.
lines.en: For each result, the paper divides the error by the bound.
lines.ja: 結果ごとに、誤差を下限で割ります。

lines.say: Below two thirds, the result is below the bound. From two thirds to two, it reaches the bound. Above two, it is away from the bound.
lines.en: Below two thirds, the result is below the bound. From two thirds to two, it reaches the bound. Above two, it is away from the bound.
lines.ja: 3 分の 2 より小さければ下限より下、3 分の 2 から 2 までなら下限に届く、2 より大きければ下限から遠い、とします。

lines.say: If the ratio and its range of uncertainty do not fall in one category, the result is undetermined.
lines.en: If the ratio and its range of uncertainty do not fall in one category, the result is undetermined.
lines.ja: 比とそのばらつきの幅が一つの区分に収まらなければ、未定とします。

lines.say: Near midnight, universal time, the set of sizes used for the comparison was empty. So no comparison was possible. This does not mean that the surface cannot be seen.
lines.en: Near midnight, universal time, the set of sizes used for the comparison was empty. So no comparison was possible. This does not mean that the surface cannot be seen.
lines.ja: 世界時の 0 時ごろは、比べるための大きさの組が空でした。そのため比べられませんでした。これは、表面が見えないという意味ではありません。

lines.say: In twenty twenty-four, twenty-two results were below the bound.
lines.en: In 2024, 22 results were below the bound.
lines.ja: 2024 年には、22 の結果が下限より下でした。

lines.say: After seeing this, the paper built the bound separately for each time of day.
lines.en: After seeing this, the paper built the bound separately for each time of day.
lines.ja: これを見た後で、論文は時刻ごとに別々に下限を作りました。

lines.say: With this new bound, none of the twenty-two stayed below. Sixteen reached the bound, and six were undetermined.
lines.en: With this new bound, none of the 22 stayed below. 16 reached the bound, and 6 were undetermined.
lines.ja: この新しい下限では、22 のどれも下に残りませんでした。16 は下限に届き、6 は未定でした。

lines.say: But this choice came after seeing the results. So the paper tested it again, on other data.
lines.en: But this choice came after seeing the results. So the paper tested it again, on other data.
lines.ja: しかし、この選び方は結果を見た後のものです。そこで論文は、別のデータでもう一度試しました。

lines.say: Before it computed anything for twenty twenty-three, the paper fixed the new bound and the methods. It also wrote down what would count as a finding that holds, or breaks.
lines.en: Before it computed anything for 2023, the paper fixed the new bound and the methods. It also wrote down what would count as a finding that holds or breaks.
lines.ja: 2023 年について何かを計算する前に、論文は新しい下限と方法を固定しました。また、どうなれば結果が保たれ、どうなれば崩れるかを書いておきました。

lines.say: Then it used four months of twenty twenty-three.
lines.en: Then it used four months of 2023.
lines.ja: そして、2023 年の 4 か月を使いました。

lines.say: In twenty twenty-three, no result of the main configuration was below the bound, in any of the four months.
lines.en: In 2023, no result of the main configuration was below the bound, in any of the four months.
lines.ja: 2023 年には、主な組み立てのどの結果も、4 か月のどれでも、下限より下ではありませんでした。

lines.say: The results near midnight could not be compared, again. Some results near noon were undetermined.
lines.en: The results near midnight could not be compared, again. Some results near noon were undetermined.
lines.ja: 0 時ごろの結果は、やはり比べられませんでした。12 時ごろの結果の一部は未定でした。

lines.say: The other findings were checked too. Four held again. One held only when the four months were taken together. One could be applied in only two months. One broke in one month. And one could not be tested.
lines.en: The other findings were checked too. Four held again. One held only when the four months were taken together. One could be applied in only two months. One broke in one month. And one could not be tested.
lines.ja: ほかの結果も確かめました。四つは再び保たれました。一つは、4 か月を合わせたときだけ保たれました。一つは、2 か月にしか当てはめられませんでした。一つは、1 か月で崩れました。一つは、試せませんでした。

lines.say: The paper says that twenty twenty-three does not make the twenty twenty-four statements stronger. It shows what the same method, fixed in advance, gives on other months.
lines.en: The paper says that 2023 does not make the 2024 statements stronger. It shows what the same method, fixed in advance, gives on other months.
lines.ja: 論文は、2023 年の結果が 2024 年の主張を強めるものではないと述べています。前もって固定した同じ方法が、ほかの月で何を与えるかを示すものです。

scenes.title: What the paper does not claim
scenes.title_ja: 論文が主張しないこと

lines.say: The bound belongs to the declared model. It is not a limit for every method.
lines.en: The bound belongs to the declared model. It is not a limit for every method.
lines.ja: 下限は、宣言したモデルのものです。あらゆる方法の限界ではありません。

lines.say: The paper does not say whether or when a mission could take a picture of a planet of another star.
lines.en: The paper does not say whether or when a mission could take a picture of a planet of another star.
lines.ja: 論文は、任務がほかの恒星の惑星を写せるかどうかや、その時期については、何も述べていません。

lines.say: It uses one camera, one colour of light, two times of day, and the stated months. It does not extend these clouds to other planets or other times.
lines.en: It uses one camera, one colour of light, two times of day, and the stated months. It does not extend these clouds to other planets or other times.
lines.ja: 使ったのは、一つのカメラ、一つの色の光、1 日の二つの時刻、そして述べた月だけです。この雲を、ほかの惑星やほかの時代に広げてはいません。

lines.say: Some things are not in the model, for example clouds on a round planet, and other kinds of noise.
lines.en: Some things are not in the model, for example clouds on a round planet, and other kinds of noise.
lines.ja: モデルに入っていないものもあります。たとえば、丸い惑星の上の雲や、ほかの種類の雑音です。

lines.say: To learn more, read the paper. The link is on this page.
lines.en: To learn more, read the paper. The link is on this page.
lines.ja: 詳しくは論文をお読みください。リンクはこのページにあります。

lines.say: This video was made with the help of AI. The voice is synthetic.
lines.en: This video was made with the help of AI. The voice is synthetic.
lines.ja: この動画は AI の助けを借りて作りました。声は合成音声です。
